title: DecryptionKey / SigningKey traits cannot be extended without semver break
description: Both DecryptionKey and SigningKey are public traits with required methods and no default implementations. Any new required method is a breaking change for all downstream implementors. Concrete problems already visible: (1) KARI decrypt requires passing the ephemeral public key from the KARI structure to the DecryptionKey impl — doing so requires a new method on DecryptionKey; (2) SigningKey has no way to advertise supported DigestAlgorithm variants. The traits will need to grow before 1.0, but every growth is a semver break. Neither trait is marked #[non_exhaustive] (which does not apply to traits) nor documented as 'sealed' or 'unstable'.
